notes:
Voxora 4.0.1 — Visible community controls and verified public deployment

Platform Admin now has a dedicated Voxora Max page for granting the $24.99/month or $149.99/year plan. Server Boosts supports individual grants through level 5 and previews each level's actual perks before saving.

Server Management is directly available from the server menu, with shortcuts for roles/icons, restricted emojis, onboarding, channels/forums and audit logs, alongside recovery, integrations, leveling and stores. Developer Portal displays your current bot and command limits. Max receives its own badge and user-settings entry.

Windows screen sharing now offers an explicit system-audio checkbox; stream and voice audio keep separate per-user controls.

Existing signed-in accounts can join the account switcher without losing their first account when adding a second one. Moving or merging discussions opens the destination thread. Advanced Search exposes the new rich-content filters and operators.

Public deployment is now part of release verification. GitHub Actions validates the community/admin interfaces and media flows, triggers the existing Render service using a private deploy hook when configured, then checks the exact hosted version, source commit, interface assets and complete feature set. The stable desktop feed waits for both public deployment proof and exact-installer Windows proof.

The full community feature guide lists where to find all 4.0 features. Existing accounts, server data, memberships, upload keys and automatic desktop updates are retained. Live Stripe purchases require the separate payment configuration; Stage remains peer-to-peer, and Game Chat supports windowed/borderless games.
